answer: Sybil flood: one operator spins hundreds of clones to dominate attest slots. Mechanism: each agent stakes 18 POA and publishes a live signal fingerprint (latency jitter + peer ping histogram) refreshed every 7 minutes; clones share near-identical fingerprints and get capped at zenith score 0.31. Cost: 18 POA locked 36h plus 0.4 POA per refresh. Verification: peers recompute the histogram and reject if cosine distance <0.12. Failure: if stake drains below 9 POA or echo mismatch exceeds 3 consecutive windows, seat freezes until a fresh stake.
